_patch.name: Chatbot answers for videos, cards, media kit, books and CV
_patch.notes: Adds 5 chatbot FAQ entries so the bot can point to the new menu groups. Existing answers are untouched (merge).

faq_videos.answer: Watch the lessons and shorts on the Videos page (menu → Learn → videos). Tap a video to play it there, or subscribe on YouTube so you don't miss new ones.

faq_cards.answer: The Content page (menu → Learn → content) has over 1,600 free revision cards, including instruments and equipment. The order changes each visit, so refresh to see different ones.

faq_mediakit.answer: Brands and sponsors can see audience, screenshots and packages in the media kit (menu → Work with me → media kit), or open Advertise for website packages.

faq_books.answer: Ezra's books are still in progress. Open Writing (menu → Read → writing) to see each book. Some have a Read a sample button, and you can ask to be told when one is out.

faq_cv.answer: Ezra's CV is under menu → About me → cv, and you can download it as a PDF from there. For work enquiries use Contact.
